text:
samir: Heads-up — staging p99 shot up from ~90ms to ~420ms after we swapped in checkpoint v2.1. Rollout blocked. :cry:
maria: saw the perf gate fail. Perf CI shows p99 spike, gating rollout. What's the quick repro?
bench-bot: perf-ci: model=v2.1 seq=512 p95=112ms p99=422ms (baseline p99=92ms). Perf gate=false.
alex: I ran a short profile on a staging pod. Flamegraph points at matmul_small_kernel dominating token-gen time.

alex: profiler snippet:
```
matmul_small_kernel       61.8%  (p99 hotspot)
kv_cache_evictions        17.2%  (high churn on short prefixes)
batching_scheduler_spin   9.6%
other                    11.4%
```

lisa: weird — tokenizer import for v2.1 changed token ids (pad/cls moved). That produces a lot more short sequences (more eos/pad patterns) and we see many tiny KV cache entries that thrash.
samir: ok — so two things: tokenizer remap increased cache churn, and runtime picked a small-kernel codepath that's slower under the new distribution. Could be a kernel-selection heuristic change in the last merge.
maria: I bisected runtime commits against staging perf. Repro goes away if I roll back commit `abc1237` (the kernel selector tweak). With old selector p99 ~95ms again.
alex: adding more detail: that commit lowered the threshold that prefers the 'large_mm' path, causing more calls to matmul_small_kernel for mid-sized sequences. Combined with the degenerated token distribution, small kernel is thrashing caches and causing scheduler contention.

samir: commands I used to repro locally:
```
./perf/run_bench.sh --model v2.1 --seq 512 --parallel 8 --iters 500
./runtime/bin/profile --pid <staging-pod-pid> --out flame.svg
```

lisa: quick sanity test: importing the checkpoint with 'preserve_ids=true' brings token-id mapping back and p99 drops ~300ms; so tokenizer remap is a real contributor.
maria: conclusion: regression is interaction of two changes — tokenizer id remap (model onboarding importer) + kernel-selection tweak (runtime). Either alone doesn't produce this magnitude.
samir: action plan: 1) revert kernel-selector tweak (hotfix PR #2210) to unblock rollout, 2) patch onboarding importer to preserve ids or add safe remap with metrics, PR #2211, 3) add an onboarding perf-smoke test that runs perf-ci on new checkpoints and checks p99 delta threshold, 4) add an assert to detect token-id drift during import.

infra: I'm adding a CI gate to run the perf-smoke for onboarding and a runtime check for kernel-selection delta metrics. Also added a health metric so deploy-bot will auto-pause rollouts when p99 delta > 2x baseline.
deploy-bot: rollout paused for v2.1 (reason: perf-gate fail) — https://deploys.internal/release/4271 :no_entry_sign:

alex: I've got a draft revert ready (branch revert/kernel-selector-abc1237). Will run CI now. If green we can push hotfix and unpause.
maria: please also include a short-term runtime tweak: if kv_cache_evictions > 5% and model.metadata.token_map_changed then prefer_large_kernel=true (just until onboarding patch lands).
samir: agreed. After hotfix we should do a postmortem: root cause = unsafe token-id remap + aggressive kernel heuristic change. We'll document detection steps and add the new onboarding perf test.
lisa: adding a quick note to onboarding docs: "verify token id stability or provide deterministic mapping with perf validation".

samir: thanks all — keeping thread here for postmortem notes. :eyes:
